content.short: LI.FI enables cross-chain asset transfers via a single API, connecting bridges and DEXs across many chains.
content.description: LI.FI provides a single API to streamline asset transfers across numerous blockchain ecosystems. It acts as a bridge between DeFi infrastructure and the application layer, consolidating essential bridges and connecting them to DEXs on multiple chains to enable cross‑chain swaps. The result is a cohesive, developer‑friendly interface that reduces complexity and friction in decentralized finance, making cross‑chain movements faster, more reliable, and accessible to both developers and users.
content.meta: LI.FI provides cross-chain asset transfers across many blockchains via a single API. Discover LI.FI and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
